name: koya_puddle
desc: Remove the whole dog man body, head, hair, arms, legs and tail completely. Leave only a very low, flat, wide puddle of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls lying on the floor, centered under where the feet stand, about as wide as the body: a thin flat oval seen from a low side angle, only about 15 to 20 pixels tall, with a slight bulge in the middle. Same pixel art style, outline and highlights. Nothing else in the image.
